items.title: UnitedHealth aims to shine 'sunlight' on No Surprises Act problems - BenefitsPRO
items.reason: UnitedHealth's public advocacy regarding No Surprises Act implementation issues is relevant to understanding industry challenges with the law's enforcement, though the excerpt alone does not confirm whether this involves litigation, regulatory action, or merely industry commentary.
items.summary: UnitedHealth is publicly highlighting operational and implementation problems with the No Surprises Act, seeking to draw attention to issues it has identified with the law's application. The company's effort to publicize these concerns suggests friction between insurers and the regulatory framework governing balance-billing protections and the Independent Dispute Resolution process. This development is relevant to revenue-cycle teams as it may signal industry-wide challenges with No Surprises Act compliance or foreshadow potential regulatory adjustments to how the law operates.
